'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****[[Taliban]] leader [[Hibatullah Akhundzada]] says that he "strenuously favors" a political settlement to the conflict between the group and the [[Afghan Government]] despite recent advancement and territorial gains by the Taliban, saying that "in spite of the military gains and advances, the Islamic Emirate [of Afghanistan]" favors a stable solution to the issue. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/18/taliban-leader-favours-political-settlement-to-afghan-conflict (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[OPEC|OPEC+]] members, particularly [[Saudi Arabia]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]], reach an agreement to increase oil production, ending disputes that caused [[Price of oil|prices]] to reach their highest level since 2014. Per the terms of the agreement, [[Russia]] will increase its production from 11 million barrels to 11.5 million by May 2022, while the other members will increase their production by 400,000 barrels per day starting in August. [https://www.rferl.org/a/opec-agreement-oil-output/31364977.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 European floods]]
**The death toll from flooding in Europe increases to 188, of which 157 died in [[Germany]] and 31 more in [[Belgium]]. The flooding is also spreading into [[Bavaria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bavaria-hit-by-floods-german-death-toll-climbs-156-2021-07-18/ (Reuters)]
**Heavy floods occur in several cities in [[Austria]] and also result in the death of a man in [[Saalbach-Hinterglemm]]. [https://www.br.de/nachrichten/meldung/hochwasser-in-oesterreich-verlagert-sich-nach-tirol,3003d873e (Bayrischer Rundfunk)]
*Heavy [[floods in India|floods]] in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], result in the deaths of 20 people. In the first incident, a [[landslide]] causes a wall to collapse, killing fourteen people. In the second, six people are killed when landslides damage homes. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/18/landslides-kill-several-in-indias-mumbai-after-monsoon-rains (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 13 people are killed and 24 more are injured when a [[petrol tanker]] overturns and catches fire between [[Kisumu]] and [[Busia, Kenya|Busia]], [[Kenya]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-57879278 (BBC News)]
*A [[cargo ship]], which was banned from sailing for failing to comply with basic security measures, sinks off the coast of [[Liberia]], leaving at least seven people missing. The ship had departed Liberia's capital [[Monrovia]] on Saturday and was heading to a port in the south of the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-seven-missing-after-ship-sinks-off-liberian-coast-2021-07-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] reports a record 131 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3,425. [https://laotiantimes.com/2021/07/18/laos-confirms-131-new-cases-of-covid-19/?amp (''The Laotian Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 153 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 7,019. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/07/18/health-ministry-covid-19-daily-death-tally-climbs-to-new-record-high-at-153/1990872 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] extends its COVID-19-related restrictions that include a curfew from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m., closure of shopping malls, and travel restrictions, to [[Chonburi Province|Chonburi]], [[Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Province|Ayutthaya]], and [[Chachoengsao Province|Chachoengsao]] [[Provinces of Thailand|province]]s after the country reports a record for the third consecutive day of 11,397 new cases of COVID-19. The restrictions in these provinces will be in effect beginning on Tuesday. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/18/thailand-expands-lockdown-as-covid-cases-continue-to-rise (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 5,926 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 53,830. [https://vietnamnews.vn/society/994959/viet-nam-reports-record-daily-increase-of-5926-new-cases-of-covid-19-on-sunday.html (Viet Nam News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[France]] imposes a mandatory requirement for a negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test result]] from the previous 24 hours for unvaccinated people travelling from [[Cyprus]], [[Greece]], the [[Netherlands]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], and the [[United Kingdom]] due to concerns over the spread of the highly contagious [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/07/17/france-tightens-covid-test-rules-for-travellers-from-uk-and-several-eu-countries (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports three deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the lowest daily death toll since August 2020. [https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2021/07/18/news/coronavirus_italia_il_bollettino_di_oggi_18_luglio-310750564/ (''La Repubblica'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda]]
***[[Rwanda]] reports a record 1,997 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 54,549. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/africa/2021-07/18/c_1310068763.htm (Xinhuanet)]
*[[Water crisis in Iran]], [[2016–2021 Iranian protests]]{{dn|date=March 2026}}
**People in [[Khuzestan Province]], Iran, take to the streets for the third consecutive day to protest water shortages. [https://iranintl.com/en/iran/protests-irans-oil-rich-region-reignite-third-consecutive-night (Iran International)]
